note: Identifiers a rpm, deb or apk purl may carry in its namespace slot: the distribution id the package repository uses (os-release ID, or the name purl-spec, syft and Trivy use). A company name is not such an identifier. Lowercase; compared case-insensitively. 'ids' is every accepted id; 'apk' and 'deb' list the ids that belong to those package types, and an id in neither list is an rpm-family id. Suggestions only propose an id that matches the package type. Verified with syft in the BomLens image: amzn (Amazon Linux 2023), ol (Oracle Linux), debian. Where the spelling a tool writes was not verified, both the dotted and the hyphenated form are listed.
